title: SAS Data Engineer
description:
Our key client is looking for a SAS Data Engineer with SC Clearance ideally, for 6 months+ on going contract. 2 days in Telford.

Please note - SC Clearance will be conducted, so need a UK National with 5+ years' continuous UK residency.

Essential Skills and Experience
Extensive commercial experience in SAS engineering, development, solution delivery and/or platform administration.
Strong hands-on SAS programming skills and a detailed understanding of enterprise SAS architectures.
Strong practical experience with SAS Viya and its core services and development capabilities.
Experience migrating or modernising legacy SAS solutions onto SAS Viya.
Experience delivering SAS solutions within cloud or hybrid-cloud environments.
Strong SQL, ETL, data integration and data engineering capability.
Experience analysing and migrating complex SAS applications, programs, data pipelines and workloads.
Strong knowledge of migration disciplines including assessment, remediation, validation, reconciliation, regression testing and cutover.
Experience engineering complex Risk, Fraud, Financial Crime or analytical solutions.
Strong scripting and automation capability, ideally within Linux-based environments.
Strong understanding of security, authentication, authorisation and data-access controls within enterprise environments.
Experience integrating SAS with databases, APIs and wider enterprise systems.
Ability to produce clear, high-quality technical designs and implementation documentation.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience taking technical ownership and leading complex areas of engineering delivery.
Strong client and stakeholder engagement skills, including technical workshops and requirements analysis.
Ability to communicate effectively with both engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
